records.description: 迷宫营地的锅前，她从「绝对不吃魔物！」的激烈抗拒到小心翼翼地尝一口，再到捧着碗追加第二碗——三个阶段表情变化是这个角色的灵魂三连。
records.prose: Marcille cautiously tastes a spoonful from her bowl beside the camp’s cooking pot. Her green eyes move from doubt to surprised interest, and her pointed ears lift slightly above the blue robe collar. A folded cloth and neatly arranged bowls fill the foreground. Warm firelight keeps the reaction in one continuous close view, allowing an unfamiliar fictional meal to become a small discovery rather than a sequence of separate panels.
